To celebrate its 12th anniversary, the high-tech cleaning company Roborock is rolling out a series of promotions from today through September 6, with discounts available on multiple robot vacuums and other products to mark the occasion.

The anniversary sale covers a wide range of products and bundles, with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, and maximum savings of up to $1,600...

Saros 20

The Saros 20 pictured above is Roborock's flagship smart robot vacuum, offering unprecedented levels of real-world intelligence and designed for larger, more complex North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, Carpet Smart System, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market. It combines dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to generate highly detailed 3D maps of the home, accurately identifying and avoiding more than 300 types of obstacles, from stray cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that detects thresholds and steps, then uses motorized legs to automatically raise the Saros 20 over them, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Similarly, the Carpet Smart System automatically adjusts the unit's height to maintain optimal suction, delivering deep cleaning even on carpets with piles up to 3 cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyzes each home's unique layout, flooring materials, and the habits of every household member to automatically optimize the cleaning schedule.

Qrevo 2 Pro

The all-new Qrevo 2 Pro makes its U.S. debut as the ultimate robot vacuum for pet households. Designed to tackle stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual anti-tangle system and 20,000 Pa of suction, delivering 100% hair removal with zero tangles. This robot vacuum easily handles pet dander and hair, kitty litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

Perhaps the toughest challenge is having pets and high-pile carpets at the same time. The Qrevo Pro 2 handles this effortlessly with its auto-detaching mop feature, leaving the mop at the charging dock to keep carpets completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa of suction with VaporFlow steam cleaning at 356°F.

Key features include up to 80 minutes of runtime—enough to clean the entire home; a 180-degree flat-lay design that reaches deep under furniture; a blue light that reveals hidden dust; and full automatic steam self-cleaning with hot-air drying once cleaning is complete.

F25 XT

If you need powerful wet-dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa of suction and SlideTech 2.0 wheels for smoother, easier cleaning.

The F25 XT provides true edge-to-edge wet-dry cleaning, delivering a perfect clean in a single pass. The JawScrapers roller uses shark-tooth-shaped anti-tangle bristles to effectively capture hair, while a continuous-pressure scraper ensures floors are left streak-free. Like the F25 Steam, it also features a 180-degree flat-lay design, with up to 60 minutes of battery life in energy-saving mode—enough to continuously clean up to 4,400 square feet before recharging.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of the most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: originally $699.99, now $429.99—a $270 saving (38% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT bundle: originally $1,899.99, now $1,269.98—a $630 saving (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT bundle: originally $999.98, now $549.98—a $450 saving (45% off)

All promotional pricing ends September 6, so don't miss out.
